rationale: Form ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲩⲍⲱⲣⲡⲁϥⲉ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲥ in line 4 has the structure of a relative perfect with 3sg.f object suffix. The root may relate to ⲍⲱⲣⲡ̄ (Lyc. for ϣⲱⲣⲡ 'arrange, establish, sweep clean') or possibly to ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲫⲟⲣⲁ. Awaiting parallel attestations.
Word in line 11 of unclear formation. The -ⲓⲁ ending suggests Greek abstract noun. Possibly corruption of κατασκευή or an unattested Greek loanword. Flagged for parallel research.

In the chapter heading 'the land of ⲡⲧⲟⲩⲁ̄ⲛⲉ.' Likely a Lycopolitan variant or dialectal contraction of either ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the light' or ⲡⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'the manifestation.' Both fit the cosmological context of the Land of Light. Confidence moderate; either reading would yield the standard Manichaean technical phrase.
